content.answer_markdown:
This Recommendation proposes these Trade Lines to rebalance the Portfolio back to its Target Allocation by Asset Class. Currently, the bond allocation is significantly below target at 40.01% versus a 65.0% target, representing a breach with a negative drift of 24.99 percentage points. Conversely, the cash allocation is substantially above target at 40.01% versus a 15.0% target, also a breach with a positive drift of 25.01 percentage points. The equity allocation is close to target and within tolerance.

To correct these breaches, the Recommendation includes:
- Selling SGOV (iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF), which is 25.01% of the Portfolio, to reduce the excessive cash allocation.
- Buying AGG (iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF), 15.62% of the Portfolio, to increase the bond allocation towards the target.
- Buying SHY (iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF), 9.37% of the Portfolio, also to increase bond exposure.

This results in a turnover of 25.0% of the Portfolio, which is above the 15% threshold, and the trade lines for SGOV and AGG exceed the 10% single Trade Line threshold, triggering the need for advisor and committee approval. The post-trade drift figures show the Portfolio will be very close to target allocations after these trades, with all asset classes within tolerance and suitability rules passing.
